title: آشنایی با یک دوست تازه
introduction: در این گفت‌وگو، دو نفر برای اولین بار با هم آشنا می‌شوند. عبارت‌ها را با صدای بلند تمرین کن.
paragraphs: Alex: Hi! Is this your first English class?
Mina: Yes, it is. My name is Mina. What’s your name?
Alex: I’m Alex. Nice to meet you!
Mina: Nice to meet you, too. Where are you from?
Alex: I’m from Canada. How about you?
Mina: I’m from Iran. What do you like doing in your free time?
Alex: I like reading and playing football.
